_README: Labelled from source. OrdersController depends on IOrderService; Program.cs registers AddScoped<IOrderService, OrderService>(), so _orders.Place resolves to OrderService.Place at run time. CachedOrderService also implements IOrderService but is never registered: dispatching to it is wrong.

hard_case.catalog: DI registration picks one of several implementations (ASP.NET AddScoped<I,T>)
